.astype(np.float32) * 0.035
            warm = 0.02 * np.clip(y / 3.2, 0, 1)
            c = np.stack([0.82 + warm - panel, 0.79 + warm - panel, 0.70 + warm - panel * 0.7], axis=-1)
            # one muted accent wall
            if (scene.accent_wall == "back" and axis == 2 and side == 0) or (scene.accent_wall == "left" and axis == 0 and side == 0):
                c = np.stack([0.22 + warm, 0.42 + warm, 0.44 + warm], axis=-1)
            base[mask] = c[mask]
    return t, normal, base


def park_ground(orig, dirs):
    dy = dirs[..., 1]
    t = (0.0 - orig[1]) / np.where(np.abs(dy) < 1e-7, 1e-7, dy)
    valid = (dy < -1e-6) & (t > 0)
    t = np.where(valid, t, INF)
    hit = orig + dirs * t[..., None]
    x, z = hit[..., 0], hit[..., 2]
    # Curved-looking central path by x width varying with z
    path = np.abs(x - 0.4 * np.sin(z * 0.22)) < (1.25 + 0.04 * np.maximum(z, 0))
    grass_noise = (np.sin(x * 4.5) + np.sin(z * 5.2) + np.sin((x + z) * 2.4)) / 3.0
    grass = np.stack([0.19 + grass_noise * 0.025, 0.48 + grass_noise * 0.045, 0.20 + grass_noise * 0.02], axis=-1)
    stone = np.stack([0.61 + grass_noise * 0.025, 0.58 + grass_noise * 0.02, 0.50 + grass_noise * 0.01], axis=-1)
    base = np.where(path[..., None], stone, grass)
    normal = np.zeros_like(dirs)
    normal[..., 1] = 1.0
    return t, normal, base


def render_chunk(scene: SceneDef, dirs: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    orig = np.asarray(scene.camera, np.float32)
    if scene.kind == "room":
        tmin, normal, base = room_surface(scene, dirs)
    else:
        base = background_sky(dirs)
        tmin, normal, ground = park_ground(orig, dirs)
        hit_ground = tmin < INF / 2
        base[hit_ground] = ground[hit_ground]
    emissive = np.zeros(tmin.shape, np.float32)
    hit_name = np.full(tmin.shape, -1, np.int16)

    for index, obj in enumerate(scene.objects):
        if obj.kind == "box":
            t, n = intersect_box(orig, dirs, obj.center, obj.size)
        elif obj.kind == "ellipsoid":
            t, n = intersect_ellipsoid(orig, dirs, obj.center, obj.size)
        elif obj.kind == "cylinder":
            t, n = intersect_cylinder(orig, dirs, obj.center, obj.size)
        else:
            continue
        mask = t < tmin
        if not np.any(mask):
            continue
        tmin[mask] = t[mask]
        normal[mask] = n[mask]
        col = np.asarray(obj.color, np.float32)
        # small face/material variation to increase depth cues
        face_tint = 0.92 + 0.08 * np.clip(n[..., 1:2], 0, 1)
        obj_color = col[None, None, :] * face_tint
        base[mask] = obj_color[mask]
        emissive[mask] = obj.emissive
        hit_name[mask] = index

    # Lighting
    light_dir = np.array([-0.42, 0.82, -0.38], np.float32)
    light_dir /= np.linalg.norm(light_dir)
    diffuse = np.clip(np.sum(normal * light_dir, axis=-1), 0.0, 1.0)
    fill = np.clip(np.sum(normal * np.array([0.35, 0.25, 0.90], np.float32), axis=-1), 0.0, 1.0)
    shade = 0.30 + 0.58 * diffuse + 0.12 * fill
    if scene.kind == "room":
        room_surface_mask = hit_name < 0
        # Interior walls and ceilings receive broad bounced light; keep them readable.
        surface_floor = room_surface_mask & (normal[..., 1] > 0.5)
        surface_ceiling = room_surface_mask & (normal[..., 1] < -0.5)
        surface_wall = room_surface_mask & ~(surface_floor | surface_ceiling)
        shade[surface_floor] = np.maximum(shade[surface_floor], 0.62)
        shade[surface_wall] = np.maximum(shade[surface_wall], 0.70)
        shade[surface_ceiling] = np.maximum(shade[surface_ceiling], 0.78)
    color = base * shade[..., None]
    if scene.kind == "park":
        sky_mask = tmin >= INF / 2
        color[sky_mask] = base[sky_mask]
    # Emissive surfaces remain bright
    color = color * (1.0 - emissive[..., None]) + np.clip(base * (1.05 + emissive[..., None] * 0.45), 0, 1) * emissive[..., None]

    # Atmospheric distance fade, subtle and scene-dependent
    dist = np.where(tmin < INF
